messages:
deploy-bot: PROD deploy initiated
 - env: prod-us-west-2
 - tag: v3.4.1-hotfix
 - commit: d9f3a1b
 - initiator: @kevin
 - canary: 2 pods / 10% traffic
 - rollout plan: 10% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100% (5m checks)
 - notes: includes hotfix for token cache bug

kevin: hold for a sec — does this include the DB migration? @maria
maria: migration is a backward-compatible noop, included in release manifest. no blocking migration.
kevin: ok proceed but keep fallback pinned to v3.4.0 for 15m
deploy-bot: fallback pin set to v3.4.0 for 15m
emma: watching canary logs, will report errors here
deploy-bot: Canary healthy after 6m — metrics ok (p95 latency +2ms), promoting to 30%
maria: seeing a brief 502 spike on one canary pod at 10:42 UTC, rolled that pod, no user impact observed
kevin: continue to 70% then hold 10m
deploy-bot: Promoted to 70% → running post-promote checks (10m)
oncall-sre: getting a small increase in 429s from a downstream service, not related to this release per the trace
deploy-bot: Rollout complete — 100% traffic on v3.4.1-hotfix
deploy-bot: Summary: duration 32m, commit d9f3a1b, canary incidents: 1 pod restart, fallback pin active until 15m from canary promote
emma: :tada: release notes posted https://redwood.dev/releases/3.4.1-hotfix
kevin: great — monitoring for 1h then remove pin
maria: creating a follow-up ticket for the downstream 429 pattern (SRE-421)
deploy-bot: Deploy closed — notify: #prod-alerts and #release-announcements
